entities.name: Founding of Wallachia & Mircea the Elder
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Basarab I's defeat of the Hungarian king at Posada (1330) secured Wallachian independence. Mircea the Elder (r. 1386–1418) expanded the principality and fought the Ottomans at Rovine (1395) and Nicopolis (1396).
